summary: The user narrowed V3-IMPROVE-01 to a finite implementation trial and authorized closure with benefit inconclusive. Retain the delivered preflight/capacity practice, repository-native diagnostic source and concise skill/report source. Accept the measured single-workload profile and prospectively recorded V3 source cohort without upgrading their evidence limits. A second workload is conditional on genuine ready work and fresh admission; no ordinary comparison exists unless separately selected before treatment. Process changes delivered; throughput benefit unproven. Comparative attempt/diagnosis and whole-family effort/cost claims remain unsupported where baseline, coverage or timestamps are absent. Preserve original failures, unknown effects and cohort owner-reported/private-currentness boundaries. Transfer still-open diagnostic publication, native/installed joins and adoption evaluation to V2-DIAG-01.4. Packaged skill publication remains with the maintained coherent release successor, and selected pinning/materialization/clean and promised retaining receiver proofs with their release/receiver owners; source never counts as installed. Original .103 candidate/journal identities, dependency-pin refusal, unknown dispatch and .104 credential/release holds remain intact. The scope decision changes no required CI, coherent or fail-closed checks, V3 unattended/no-human lifecycle requirement, V3-ENV/UTEL status or other owning acceptance. This supersedes the initial design requirement that this trial wait for two cohorts and installed adoption, without declaring those transferred outcomes complete. Further experiments require separate selection.
title: Finite process trial closes with throughput benefit unproven and open adoption transfers
